elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: TrueLink warrants that the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: The Interface and all related software are warranted to conform in all material respects to their documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty lasts only 90 days following delivery.
The Services warranty lasts only 30 days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedy includes repair or replacement of non-conforming software and re-performance of non-conforming Services, at TrueLink's option.
The remedy includes a refund of fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No warranty of compliance with applicable laws is included.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No warranty regarding malicious code is included.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The Interface and all related software are warranted to conform in all material respects to their documentation for 90 days following delivery.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: Hosting Services and Support Services are warranted to be performed professionally and workmanlike for 30 days following performance.
